Unlimited, Instant Engagement

HumAIns are intelligent agents with infinite scalability, capable of executing millions of actions simultaneously without taking a break. You can control the number of active agents with a press of a button. HumAIns continuously evolve and improve thanks to our patent-pending and patented training methods.

Around-the-Clock Optimization

Our voice agents are available all the time and can proactively call customers and lead the conversation. Your AI agents aren’t phased by peak customer call traffic.

​

Your AI agents optimize every call to achieve the best response. They can A/B test conversation approaches, analyze call statistics, and optimize calls for factors like time of day and geographic location. HumAIns bring growth hacking techniques to the realm of customer care.

You’re In Control

HumAIns provide a comprehensive control center for their activities including call quality management, moderation control, and real-time analysis of each call. You can see what your AI agents said and even understand why they said it. Their alignment, precision, proactiveness, and agility make them the ideal choice for handling enterprise-level tasks.

Cognitive OS

Technology

Humains' Cognitive OS is a cutting-edge conversational AI platform offering an unprecedented blend of adaptability, precision, and cognitive complexity akin to the human brain.
 
We have engineered this advanced system as a transformative foundation for human-computer interaction, facilitating the creation of proactive agents primed for outbound tasks such as sales development and other proactive roles.

​

The Cognitive OS operates on a hybrid of deterministic and nondeterministic state machines. It decomposes tasks into multiple states, each with distinct characteristics. These states can handle tasks such as analyzing, planning, reflecting, and conversing.

Explore Our Technology
AI Agents Evolution:

Autonomy Levels

From Chatbots to Managers, from Assistants to Sales Agents

LEVEL 4

Self-Managed AI Agents

AI: I've detected a drop in our performance and made some changes in the engagement strategy, we're generating 7.5% more revenues now.

Human: Wow, this is amazing!

Operates proactively. Anticipates needs and performs complex actions independently.

LEVEL 1

Basic Template Agents 

Human: Set a reminder for tomorrow at 9 AM.
AI: Reminder set for tomorrow at 9 AM.

Simple input → simple output.

No context awareness.

LEVEL 2

Context Aware Agents

Human: Change it to 1 PM.
AI: I've updated your reminder to 1 PM tomorrow.

Maintains context. Understands references ("it").

LEVEL 3

Multi-Step Agents

Human: Research about the best AI agents for debt collection, summarize the results.
AI: Here are the top 3 solutions for AI agents for debt collection

Handles complex tasks. Plans and executes multiple steps independently.

Our Philosophy

We believe AI should promote prosperity and improve our lives.

1

We are dedicated to customer success through powerful AI technology. 

2

We believe AI should give humans new opportunities by streamlining and even reducing the work needed to perform menial or emotionally-difficult tasks.

3

We trust AI to lead the conversation and believe that the technology we have built takes customer care to the next level.

4

We believe a tiered, human-in-the-loop approach is vital for all AI implementations.

5

1

A new lead is captured.

2

The user is invited to interact with the Autonomous SDR agent.

3

The agent interacts with users, asking questions to qualify leads and providing info to answer queries.

4

Qualified leads receive an email containing a calendar invite.

5

The agent updates the dashboard, providing a brief summary, assigning conversation rankings, and offering insightful recommendations.
